rules.msg: WEB A02 JWT alg:none signature-strip token presented [high]
rules.raw: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"WEB A02 JWT alg:none signature-strip token presented [high]"; flow:established,to_server; http.header; content:"eyJhbGciOiJub25l"; fast_pattern; pcre:"/(?:authorization|cookie|token)[^\r\n]*eyJhbGciOiJub25l/i"; classtype:web-application-attack; metadata: asset_category web-mixed, owasp A02-Cryptographic-Failures, attack_target Server, mitre_tactic_id TA0006, mitre_tactic_name Credential-Access, mitre_technique_id T1556, mitre_technique_name Modify-Authentication-Process, kill_chain Exploitation, confidence high, signature_severity Critical, deployment Perimeter, network_mode plain, cve none, poc_ref tests/poc/9600001_jwt-alg-none/poc.sh, tag jwt-alg-none, created_at 2026_05_19, updated_at 2026_05_19, author huntingyuk; sid:9600001; rev:1;)

description.attack: OWASP A02 — JWT `alg:none`: penyerang menanggalkan tanda tangan token JWT dan menyetel algoritma ke 'none'.
description.impact: Pemalsuan token = bypass autentikasi / privilege escalation.
description.detects: Base64url blok-aligned dari header {"alg":"none → `eyJhbGciOiJub25l` pada token yang dikirim.
